title: Panasonic 4KTV-0SU (Skyworth-built, device SW4H, product SW4H_PANATV, MediaTek m7332), Android TV 10 (API 29),
header:
Panasonic 4KTV-0SU (Skyworth-built, device SW4H, product SW4H_PANATV, MediaTek m7332), Android TV 10 (API 29),
firmware QTG3.200617.002 (2023-07-02), security patch 2023-02-05. Fingerprint Panasonic/SW4H_PANATV/SW4H:10.
armeabi-v7a, 1920x1080 at 320 dpi, ~1.7 GB RAM, /data 4.1 GB (90% full before debloating).
Classic Android TV home, not Google TV: the stock launcher is com.google.android.tvlauncher.

Stock launcher:  com.google.android.tvlauncher
Live TV app:     com.smartdevice.livetv  (Skyworth's Live TV / input OSD; keep it, the Inputs menu opens it)
Inputs:          com.mediatek.tvinput (HDMI 1-3, AV, tuner). Never disable any com.mediatek.* package.
HOME claimers:   tvlauncher, Settings' FallbackHome, and com.google.android.tungsten.setupwraith.
setupwraith OWNS THE SAVED WI-FI NETWORK on this set (dumpsys wifi cname), so it stays
enabled: disabling it would delete the network and drop ADB. Home is set explicitly with
`cmd package set-home-activity` instead.
Updates:         no separate firmware-update package exists on this firmware; updates live in Settings.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/panasonic-4ktv-0su/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/panasonic-4ktv-0su/debloat.txt
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Disabled before this debloat, so not listed (restore.sh would turn them ON): com.sky.market,
com.smartdevice.tvworkwithalexa.

Status: disabled in one batch on one TV on 2026-10-20, then checked with remote-key injection and
screenshots: stock home (sponsored "Daily Play" row gone), Live TV, HDMI input switching, YouTube
playback, and the launcher installed as Home. Nothing broke in that testing, but the list had only
hours of real use when submitted: treat it as a starting point and re-enable anything you miss.

Quirks on this firmware, all checked on the TV:
- USB debugging alone does not open port 5555; the separate network-debugging switch plus a restart did.
- The TV does not answer ping. Check reachability with port 5555 or the Chromecast port 8009.
- setupwraith claims HOME here (it does not on the TH-40HS550K). Home set with `cmd package
set-home-activity` held after the stock launcher was disabled; no setup-wizard takeover seen.
- The stock launcher keeps YouTube Music and Play Movies tiles after those apps are disabled: built-in
shortcuts, not the apps. Irrelevant once launcher/ is Home.
- HDMI-CEC devices are named in the input list ("HDMI Apple TV").
- About 1.7 GB of RAM; MemAvailable went from 775 MB to 1.0 GB after this list, /data from 90% to 82% full.
